definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 《元史》漫無採摭，僅存李謙之《議祿》、《曆經》之初稿。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing at random; only the draft of Li Qian's Discourse on Emoluments and Calendar Classic survives.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: The Yuan History excerpts almost nothing at random; only Li Qian's Deliberations and the first draft of the Calendar Classic survive.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: Received 《議祿》 is corrupt for 《議錄》 (Siku 僅存李謙之議録曆經之初稿). The Yuan History says Li Qian was commissioned to write the 曆議 (Calendar Deliberations), while the 曆經 was compiled by Xu Heng, Wang Xun, Guo Shoujing and others (衡恂守敬等所撰曆經及謙曆議故存). 李謙之議錄、曆經之初稿 is two parallel phrases. Both English fields invent a "Discourse on (Official) Emoluments" and attribute the Calendar Classic draft to Li Qian.

definiteTranslationRepairs.zh: 而法原之目七：曰句股測望，曰弧矢割圓，曰黃赤道內外度，曰白道交周，曰日月五星平立定三差，曰裏差刻漏。
definiteTranslationRepairs.before: The headings of origins of method are seven: called gnomonic surveying; called arc-sagitta circle division; called ecliptic and equator inner and outer degrees; called white-path crossing circuit; called sun, moon, and five planets mean, upright, and fixed three differences; called terrestrial parallax and clepsydra.
definiteTranslationRepairs.after: The headings of origins of method are seven: called gnomonic surveying; called arc-sagitta circle division; [called ecliptic–equator difference;] called ecliptic and equator inner and outer degrees; called white-path crossing circuit; called sun, moon, and five planets mean, upright, and fixed three differences; called terrestrial parallax and clepsydra.
definiteTranslationRepairs.reason: The sentence announces seven headings (法原之目七) but the received text lists six: 曰黃赤道差 was lost by eye-skip before 曰黃赤道內外度. The Siku text has it, and the chapter has the section 黃赤道差 (s0075). Both English fields say "seven" and list six; the missing heading is restored in brackets.
